program.name: Home Forge: 4-Day Dumbbell Split
program.description: A complete 4-day Upper/Lower split designed exclusively for dumbbells and bodyweight. No specialized machines required.
guidelines: Use adjustable or pair dumbbells with manageable micro-increments.
Maintain strict form and full range of motion to maximize hypertrophy without heavy machines.

workouts.title: Chest & Back
workouts.focus: Horizontal dumbbell pressing, lat rows, and shoulder volume

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Retract shoulder blades into bench, plant feet firmly, and hold dumbbells over chest.
Lower dumbbells with control, maintaining vertical forearms and elbows tucked at 45–60°.
Lower into a deep, comfortable chest stretch at bottom without shoulder discomfort.
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward in a smooth arc, stopping just short of touching.
avoid: Clanking dumbbells together at top (removes muscular tension from pecs).
Flaring elbows perpendicular to torso ('T' position).
Allowing forearms to angle inward or outward.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Place same-side knee and hand firmly on flat bench; keep spine flat and hips square to floor.
Let dumbbell hang directly below shoulder, feeling a full lat stretch at bottom.
Pull dumbbell back toward hip crease in a sweeping arc, driving elbow toward ceiling.
Squeeze lat at top, then lower dumbbell under control into full extension.
avoid: Twisting or rotating torso at the top of the pull to heave the weight.
Rounding lower back during the stretch phase.
Pulling straight up to chest like a bicep curl rather than arcing back to hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand tall with a slight forward torso hinge (10–15°) and dumbbells at your sides.
Raise dumbbells outward toward walls in the scapular plane (~30° in front of torso).
Lead slightly with elbows until arms are parallel to floor; keep wrists neutral.
Hold peak contraction for a split second, then lower under strict control.
avoid: Shrugging upper traps toward ears to heave the dumbbells up.
Rocking torso back and forth or using hip thrust for momentum.
Internally rotating wrists/shoulders at top (thumbs pointed down).

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Stand tall holding dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Keep elbows pinned close to ribs; curl dumbbells upward in line with shoulders.
Squeeze brachialis and forearms intensely at top of rep.
Lower dumbbells under strict control to full arm extension without swinging.
avoid: Rocking hips or swinging torso to initiate curl.
Flaring elbows out to sides.
Letting wrists flex or curl inward.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
cues: Set hands slightly wider than shoulder width; create a rigid plank from head to heels.
Lower body as a single unit until chest touches or hovers 1 inch above floor.
Keep elbows tucked at roughly 45 degrees (forming an arrowhead, not a 'T').
Press floor away to full arm extension, actively spreading shoulder blades apart at the top.
avoid: Sagging hips into lumbar hyperextension or piking hips into the air.
Flaring elbows straight out to sides (shoulder impingement risk).
Craning neck down to touch floor before chest.

workouts.title: Quads & Hams
workouts.focus: Goblet squats, dumbbell RDLs, and calf development

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Cup hands under top dumbbell head, holding it vertically flush against upper chest.
Set feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out 20–30°.
Sit hips down between knees to full depth, letting elbows track inside knees.
Drive through mid-foot to stand, squeezing glutes at the top without hyperextending.
avoid: Letting dumbbell drift forward away from chest (increases spinal moment arm).
Heels lifting off the floor or lower back rounding at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold dumbbells against front of thighs with shoulders packed and core braced.
Soften knees and push hips straight back horizontally into a deep hamstring stretch.
Keep dumbbells tracking tightly along thighs and shins.
Reverse movement by driving hips forward once hamstrings are fully lengthened.
avoid: Rounding lumbar spine to chase floor depth.
Letting dumbbells swing forward away from legs.
Squatting the knees forward.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Place laces of rear foot on bench; step front foot forward into a balanced split stance.
Maintain a slight forward torso lean (~15°) with a braced, neutral spine.
Descend until back knee hovers an inch above the floor, front knee tracking over toes.
Drive straight up through the whole front foot (tripod foot: heel, big toe, pinky toe).
avoid: Front heel lifting off floor or front knee caving inward (valgus collapse).
Pushing aggressively off rear foot instead of loading the front working leg.
Hyperextending lower back by trying to stay unnaturally upright.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
cues: Place ball of working foot on edge of step; lightly hold wall or rack with one hand for balance.
Keep working leg straight (micro-soft knee) and let non-working leg hang freely.
Lower heel below step level into a deep calf stretch; pause for 2 full seconds.
Drive forcefully through big toe to full height, squeezing calf hard at the top.
avoid: Bouncing rapidly at the bottom without pausing.
Bending working knee to spring body upward.
Rolling ankle outward onto pinky toe at peak height.

exercises.name: Side Plank
cues: Lie on side with elbow directly beneath shoulder, forearms flat, feet stacked or staggered.
Lift hips off floor to create a straight, unbroken diagonal line from head to heels.
Keep shoulders and hips square (stacked vertically), bracing obliques and glutes.
Maintain steady breathing and keep head aligned with spine.
avoid: Hips sagging toward floor or piking backward.
Rotating chest and shoulders forward toward floor.
Shrugging supporting shoulder up toward ear.

workouts.title: Shoulders & Arms
workouts.focus: Incline pressing, chest-supported rows, floor pressing, and biceps

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set bench to 30 degrees; retract shoulder blades and plant feet firmly on floor.
Lower dumbbells under control to sides of upper chest, elbows angled at 45–60°.
Feel a deep stretch across upper pectorals at the bottom with forearms vertical.
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward over upper chest without clanking them together.
avoid: Arching lower back excessively to turn the press into a flat bench press.
Flaring elbows perpendicular to torso.
Banging dumbbells together at top of rep.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Set bench to a 30–45 degree incline; rest chest firmly against pad with feet planted.
Allow dumbbells to hang straight down at full arm extension, letting shoulder blades stretch open.
Drive elbows back toward hips, retracting shoulder blades firmly at peak contraction.
Lower dumbbells under control into a deep, full back stretch without chest lifting.
avoid: Heaving chest off bench pad to generate momentum.
Craning neck upward toward ceiling.
Pulling with arms/biceps instead of driving through elbows and scapulae.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie flat on floor with knees bent and feet flat; retract shoulder blades into floor.
Hold dumbbells over chest with wrists neutral and elbows tucked at ~45° from torso.
Lower dumbbells under control until upper arms lightly rest flat against floor.
Pause for a split second to remove momentum, then press explosively to full extension.
avoid: Bouncing elbows or triceps hard off the floor.
Flaring elbows wide toward 90 degrees.
Letting wrists collapse backward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand tall with a slight forward torso hinge (10–15°) and dumbbells at your sides.
Raise dumbbells outward toward walls in the scapular plane (~30° in front of torso).
Lead slightly with elbows until arms are parallel to floor; keep wrists neutral.
Hold peak contraction for a split second, then lower under strict control.
avoid: Shrugging upper traps toward ears to heave the dumbbells up.
Rocking torso back and forth or using hip thrust for momentum.
Internally rotating wrists/shoulders at top (thumbs pointed down).

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Set bench to 55–60 degrees; sit back with head and torso supported by pad.
Let arms hang straight down toward floor, keeping upper arms strictly vertical.
Curl dumbbells upward, supinating wrists (palms up) as you ascend into a hard bicep peak.
Lower under strict 2–3 second control into a deep, full stretch at the bottom.
avoid: Swinging upper arms or elbows forward to bypass the bottom stretch.
Lifting head or shoulders off bench pad during the curl.
Cutting the eccentric stretch short.

workouts.title: Glutes & Core
workouts.focus: Unilateral leg loading, glute development, and core stability

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Hold dumbbells at sides; place entire foot flat on a knee-height box or bench.
Lean torso slightly forward (~10–15°) to center weight over front working leg.
Dorsiflex rear foot (pull toes up) and drive through front foot to stand onto box.
Step down slowly under strict 2–3 second eccentric control without dropping.
avoid: Pushing or springing off the bottom calf/toes to assist ascent.
Letting front knee collapse inward during step-up.
Slamming down onto floor during descent.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie flat on back with arms extended toward ceiling and knees/hips bent at 90 degrees.
Press lower back aggressively flat into floor, eliminating all space under spine.
Slowly extend opposite arm overhead and opposite leg straight toward floor while exhaling fully.
Hover limb 1–2 inches off floor, then return under control while maintaining flat spine.
avoid: Lower back arching or peeling off floor during extension.
Moving limbs rapidly or holding breath.
Letting extended heel slam or rest on floor.
